Shared contract.Behavior / strategy: This is the FINAL GEOMETRY strategy of a generative Semantic district process, NOT a classification or GIS publication operation. Run AFTER the companion district-programs strategy has selected viable strong district types under founding-template rules and those type programs have influenced City land-competition, civic/defense investments, major movement and construction over spatial feedback passes. Treat the existing City stencil as a strong organizing and built-intensity prior for the principal urban body, not as a hard constraint on development outside it. Gather the viable, competing district programs with their explicit roles, anchors, rights, physical signatures and spatial pressure; retain authored districts and built/civic history. Perform constrained space filling with meaningful voids across the urban districtable body into 7–14 permanent, coherent, nonoverlapping adjacent district polygons; let barriers, rivers, main routes, walls/gates, active programs, occupied/ceremonial land, template axes and city character decide where each type is embodied. A district's dominant type, physical expression, major open spaces and important relationships are AUTHORITATIVE generated data, not labels inferred from density after a neutral partition. Type boundaries can be exaggerated and sharply distinct to suit the setting, while retaining viable mixed uses and physically supported transitions. Do not tile the entire countryside or force road stops and farms into districts. Preserve parks, markets, sacred ground, commons and water as intentional open/void forms within the partition. After finalization, publish same types/edges/IDs for Street inheritance. Districts themselves do not own population/BuiltUp/Standing or draw building footprints.

Shared contract.Behavior / strategy: Execute EARLY in City formation and co-iterate BEFORE the geometry is settled. (1) Read the selected settlement/founding template's eligible district-program vocabulary (dominant roles, rights, social/civic/physical needs, indicative built intensity, open-space arrangement, network/fortification relationships and distinctive morphological signature), inherited/authored district types, society concentrations, major works and credible institutions. (2) Select an appropriate diversity of 7–14 distinct provisional district instances with clear PRIMARY roles/types, real supporting conditions/anchors and spatial aspirations; use conditioned competition/selection, not a quota that every city must include a slum, noble district, trade ward or civic precinct. Where justified by available people, wealth, rights, sponsors, culture, hazards and template, choose expressive district types; a cathedral precinct may be monumental, a citadel ward fortified, a dense under-resourced quarter labyrinthine, a wealthy residential district spacious or a trade ward visibly organized for freight. These ARE causally grounded intentionally exaggerated physical identities, not labels added to neutral geometry; allow supporting mixed uses inside each. (3) Represent each provisional district as a coherent area-scale program with candidate anchors, type/identity, spatial influence over the strongly stencil-favored urban interior, reserved/open land and needed access/defense, and demands on construction, land-competition, movement and collective investment. (4) Those owners actively respond in repeated current-state spatial passes; receive feasibility, economic activity, access and built-form feedback, intensify or weaken a type, move/reconfigure candidate extents and negotiate boundaries. Economic/resource/historical conditions can defeat ineligible proposed types. Do NOT generate a completed district polygon from a point-growth flood or tile the whole countryside. (5) Once physical pressures and type programs have shaped the urban morphology, invoke town.districts/district-partition to make the FINAL authoritative void-aware space-filling district polygons from the active programs. City stencil is a strong dense development prior, not a zero-outside build rule. Districts are the causal source of type-specific form; classification/publication merely exports the final identity and geometry.
